ABOUT US

Propel builds technology that strengthens the social safety net in America. We envision a future where every American has the tools and resources they need to thrive.

The safety net's strength depends not just on funding, but delivery. Propel exists to dramatically improve how government benefits are delivered. Managing SNAP benefits, picking a D-SNP plan, or protecting against EBT theft should feel as seamless as Apple Pay or Netflix.

Governments struggle to build modern, scalable user experiences. We don't.

Over 5 million Americans trust Propel today. We've grown revenue 35% YoY and are reinventing entire benefit categories, including Medicare, around the real needs of low-income Americans. We're building a high-growth, high-ceiling, sustainable for-profit company where impact drives revenue.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a results-oriented Product Data Scientist to help Propel's product teams, starting with Marketplace, make better decisions through experimentation, personalization, and analysis.

This role matters because the Marketplace design and ranking changes we've made so far have helped our users find products and services they need, and we want every next decision grounded in evidence like that. You'll work in SQL or Python, along with AI tools. Much of the job is explaining what the data says to product and business teammates who aren't data scientists.

What success looks like in this role:

 - Make Marketplace decisions on evidence. You'll design, run, and read A/B tests on Marketplace product and backend changes. 

 - Inform bigger company decisions. You'll go beyond single experiments with deeper research and business analysis that shapes where Propel invests. 

 - Keep Marketplace data trustworthy. You'll help maintain the pipelines and metrics the team relies on to make decisions.

What You Bring:

 - Fluency in SQL and familiarity with Python

 - A knack for turning a vague product question into an analysis with just the right level of complexity

 - Comfort with probability distributions, cost-benefit analysis, and the ability to design experiments that answer real decisions

 - Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates

 - A track record of picking up new techniques quickly and putting them to work

Not required, but helpful:

 - Experience maintaining data pipelines

 - Experience in a startup or other setting where you worked through ambiguity and set your own priorities

 - Knowledge of government services, especially safety net programs like SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, SSDI, Medicaid, and Section 8

This role may not be for you if:

We'd rather be upfront about how we work, so you can decide if it's right for you.

 - Many of the questions you'll work on aren't fully defined yet. You'll help shape what we measure as you go, so if you want a fixed set of metrics and a stable roadmap, this may not be the right fit.

 - Part of the job is keeping data pipelines and metrics healthy, not only analysis. If you want to focus purely on research and modeling, this probably won't feel like a good fit.

 - You'll sit on our central Data Science team but work day to day with Marketplace, and your focus may extend to other teams over time. If you want to stay in one product area long term, we can't promise that.

 - This role may not be for you if you want to do a sizable amount of machine learning
